claims.text: Mitoxantrone: IV chemotherapeutic for MS (affects DNA repair and RNA synthesis);
claims.quote: Mitoxantrone: This is an IV-administered chemotherapeutic agent used to treat multiple sclerosis due to its effects on DNA repair and RNA synthesis.

claims.text: use limited by adverse effects, incl amenorrhea and alopecia.
claims.quote: However, its use is limited due to the various adverse effects that have been documented, including amenorrhea and alopecia.
